To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we are developing a process control strategy to determine the optimal combination of process parameters to assure welding quality while maximizing the life of the electrodes.
we have been able to identify and classify electrode degradation and to correlate this with the welding quality of the produced part.
we are able to predict electrode degradation based on welding process parameters and the quality of the welded joints.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the electrode degradation during an aluminium-based resistance welding process, the analysis of the process data and its application for the detection of process changes, and the development of an algorithm that allows to determine the optimal combination of parameters to improve the quality of the welding and extend the electrodes' life.
the development of an intelligent system for the control of the resistance spot welding process, with the final aim to increase the quality of produced parts and reduce the production costs.

(i) the detection of the electrode state degradation and its correlation to the welding process parameters and (ii) to determine the optimal welding parameters for each electrode degradation state assuring welding quality and increasing the electrode's life.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach will allow to increase the quality of produced parts by detecting and correcting the welding process degradation and by improving the process parameters.
the proposed analysis will allow to determine the optimal combination of parameters for each electrode, assuring welding quality and increasing the electrodes' life.

a process analysis of the welding data and image processing of the produced parts can be used to detect the state of the electrodes, the optimal parameters for the welding and the optimal time for the electrode replacement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a fuzzy logic-based algorithm is developed to assess the electrode degradation and the welding process.
a process data analysis is performed using fuzzy logic algorithms, to advance toward a Zero Defect Manufacturing scenario.
the proposed approach allows to improve the quality and reduce the cost of the produced parts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed methodology can be applied to any other process where the quality of the final product depends on the degradation of the tools used.
the electrode degradation state can be assessed using image data from the production line.
the electrode degradation can be predicted using the welding parameters.
